youtube.title: How to Write a Cleaning Quote From Walkthrough Notes With AI (You Set the Prices)
youtube.description:
How to write a cleaning quote from walkthrough notes: AI types, you price it.
For cleaning business owners and home service business owners.
Jobber, "Blue Collar Strong: The 2026 Home Service Trends Report": a survey of 1,050 home service business owners across the United States, conducted through Conjointly in December 2025. Of the owners who have adopted AI, 54% use it for quoting, 52% for invoicing and 51% for business writing.

Steps (the prompt is an example):
1. Paste your walkthrough notes into an AI chat app.
2. Add your price list and this prompt: "Turn these notes into an itemized quote. Use only my price list. Flag anything I didn't price."
3. Check every line against your own rates before it goes anywhere.

Send this to whoever writes your quotes.
